propositions: A deterministic offline AST gate must flag prohibited config/credential reads in non-seam modules by category: ambient env reads, helper-shim calls, load_config calls, getattr(os.environ) reads, provider-credential reads outside boundaries, and below-seam backend-registry accesses.

The gate must reuse gen_env_registry's scan, KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS, and literal matchers as the single source for env-read detection rather than duplicating parsing logic, and treat shim-shaped callees absent from the table and dynamic env reads as unresolved-env-read failures.

The owner registry must derive credential names from _child_env.owned_secret_names(), backend keys from static @register decorator AST scans (not the import-time-empty _REGISTRY), and env baseline from gen_env_registry.scan + _deprecations.REGISTRY, with provider-credential boundaries enumerated distinctly from composition roots.
Receiver-object aliasing (src = os.environ; src.get()) must be resolved so that credential reads via aliased references are detected and classified correctly.

A legacy-exception set of exact path+symbol+rationale entries must cover current below-seam reads so the gate is introducible without product-code changes, with a drift self-test failing if new unowned env names or credential spellings appear.

The gate must expose check(root)->list[str] and main(argv)->int contracts, reject path-glob exceptions structurally, run offline with no CI/network dependency, and exit 0 on the current tree with no findings.
